title: Why are old Mumbai buildings black at the top? (Not pollution)
description:
The black streaks on old Mumbai buildings are mostly living growth: algae, cyanobacteria and fungi on plaster that stays wet through about 2.5 metres of monsoon rain a year. They are darkest where water runs off the parapet and window ledges.
Sources: IMD Santacruz rainfall normals 1991 to 2020; RIBuild (algae growth on facades); LNEC facade study. Educational content, not advice.
